scope: All 108 answers adjudicated against the fixed key, limited to requested material; source spot checks are not a final source audit.
methodology: Judge the answer rather than its self-reported support label.
Equivalent wording and logical coverage within the same answer are accepted.
Do not require unrequested context merely because it is included in the key.
No facts are borrowed across answers.
Material omissions remain partial and contradictory rulings remain incorrect.
Correct source-limit disclosures can match this key, but do not produce an unconditional core pass.
